importMenu.name: Import Content
importMenu.label: Open Importer
importMenu.hint: Import or update the tables, journals and recipe books of Potion Crafting & Gathering in this world.

showImportOnStartup.name: Show Importer on Startup
showImportOnStartup.hint: Open the content importer when a Gamemaster loads the world.

importApp.title: Potion Crafting & Gathering: Import Content

harvesting.label: Set Creature Harvesting
harvesting.hint: Replaces Gatherer's creature harvesting configuration with harvesting tables for each creature type (Beast, Dragon, Monstrosity, ...), using this module's creature parts. The Creature Harvesting journal and its tables are imported if missing.
harvesting.done: Potion Crafting & Gathering: Gatherer's creature harvesting is now configured.

update.label: Update Imported Documents
update.hint: Replace documents already in the world with the latest version from the compendium. Ownership, folders, pages or results you added and gathering progress are kept.
update.warning: Updating replaces each imported document as a whole: your edits to imported recipes, journals and roll tables, flags written by other modules on them, and the drawn state of table results are overwritten.

importApp.done: Potion Crafting & Gathering: {created} documents imported, {updated} updated. Keep this module enabled, the items are stored in its compendiums.

newContent.title: Potion Crafting & Gathering: New Content
newContent.intro: This version of Potion Crafting & Gathering adds new content that is not in this world yet:

items.harvesting: The Creature Harvesting journal, with harvesting pages and tables for each creature type
items.smithing: A smithing recipe book with its items

newContent.hint: Open the importer to choose what to import. You can open it later from the module settings.

versionCheck.outdated: Potion Crafting & Gathering: {title} {version} is outdated. Update it to {required} or later for the recipes and gathering journals to work.
versionCheck.unavailable: Potion Crafting & Gathering: {title} is not installed or not active. The content can still be imported, but crafting or gathering automation needs {title} {required} or later.
